seo.title: Digital vouchers: €1,500 to digitize your restaurant
seo.description: In 2020, the state is launching a €1,500 boost: the digital voucher for digitizing your restaurant!

fields.breadcrumb-text-2: Digital voucher: a €1,500 boost for the digitalization of your restaurant!
fields.title-post: Digital voucher: a €1,500 boost for the digitalization of your restaurant!
fields.rt-blog-html:
The "connected commerce" is more than ever topical, whether it is the restaurant sector or other types of establishments such as florists, bookstores, grocery stores ...

To better support independent merchants and craftsmen with fewer than 10 employees, the Ile-de-France region has set up a digital voucher worth up to 1,500 euros, to improve their presence and sales on the Internet.

The 3 objectives of the digital check:

1) Improve digital management;

2) Develop the "web to store" (increase the flow in store thanks to digital marketing);

3) Boost sales through e-commerce.

If you were hesitating until now to invest in digital, now is the time to take the plunge! Click and collect, drive, marketplace, online ordering solution... this help can really help you to keep your restaurant active in the context, and especially to prepare the future in a serene way.

What projects can you fund with this assistance?

The amount of the grant supports two categories of expenses (one or the other). On the one hand, what we consider to be operating expenses in the sense that they are not assets but liabilities: subscriptions to digital management solutions, such as the Innovorder cash register software, the online ordering or the loyalty solution for example! They can also be investments in web advertising, loyalty, SEO, hosting or domain name...

On the other hand, you can apply for this grant to reduce your capital expenses: purchase of licenses or screens, etc.

Are you eligible for the digital check?

If you meet the following conditions, yes! All you have to do is follow the official procedures to benefit from it.

Important note: the amount you will receive depends on the amount of the investment

The subsidy is calculated according to the amount of money you spend before tax. For example, if you spend between 300 and 599€ HT, the amount of the check will be 150€.

To obtain the maximum, i.e. 1500€, you will have to invest at least 3000€, which implies to think about the digitalization strategy that you must implement in priority!

Is the digital cheque compatible with Innovorder solutions?

Absolutely! Contact our experts to talk about it and to see how our solutions can help you take your business to the next level.
